# **One Provider
# for Global Health
# Insurance and Benefits
# **

International health insurance for Individuals and Employers.
Find the right plan for you below:

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.
[ INTERNATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE (12+ MONTHS) ][106]
[ SHORT TERM HEALTH INSURANCE (3-9 MONTHS) ][107]
[Young women smiling at camera]

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.
[ GET A QUOTE ][108]
[Two people working together on a tablet]

## **International Health Insurance Services included with your cover**

You have access to a range of services gathered in one convenient hub to help protect you and your
family from preventable health risks. Our services include Telehealth Hub, Expat Assistance
programme, Fitness coaching App, Nutrition Hub, Travel Security and more.

## Vora - AI Health Coach for Workouts, Nutrition, Recovery & Meditation

Vora is the all-in-one AI health coach for iPhone. It combines personalized AI workout plans, photo
nutrition logging, recovery tracking, guided meditation, cycle tracking, and voice-first coaching in
a single app. Used by 1,000+ athletes and busy professionals.

## AI-Powered Workout Plans

Get personalized training programs generated by AI based on your goals, fitness level, schedule, and
daily recovery. Choose from 6 distinct AI coach personalities. Progressive overload is tracked
automatically.

## Photo Nutrition Logging

Snap a photo of any meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and provides a full macro and
micronutrient breakdown - calories, protein, carbs, fat, and 35+ nutrients. No manual entry
required. Barcode scanning also available.

## Recovery Tracking & Vora Health Score

A daily 0-100 composite recovery score based on HRV, resting heart rate, sleep quality, and strain.
Vora recommends training intensity based on your recovery state to prevent overtraining.

## Voice-First AI Coaching

Powered by ElevenLabs conversational AI. Log workouts, meals, and health data entirely by voice. Ask
your coach questions, request a meditation session, or get a daily plan - all hands-free on iPhone
and Apple Watch.

## Guided Meditation & Mindfulness

Voice AI-guided meditation sessions on demand. Breathing exercises and mindfulness routines
accessible by voice command on iPhone or Apple Watch.

## Cycle Tracking

Track period, fertility window, ovulation, and symptoms. Workout recommendations automatically adapt
to your menstrual cycle phase for optimized performance and recovery.

## AI Daily Planning

A smart daily timeline with proactive suggestions for workouts, meals, hydration, and rest - adapts
to your calendar, recovery state, and goals.

## Apple Watch & 500+ Integrations

Native Apple Watch app with Live Activities, haptic timers, and voice logging. Connects with Apple
Health, Garmin, Oura, WHOOP, Fitbit, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Peloton, and 500+ more platforms.

## Pricing

Vora is free to download. Vora Pro is $12.99/month or $89.99/year ($7.50/month). Every new user
receives a 7-day free trial of Pro. No commitment required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

*Is Vora free to use?*
  Yes. Vora offers a generous free tier with core features including AI workout plans, basic
  nutrition logging, and recovery tracking. Vora Pro ($12.99/month or $89.99/year) unlocks unlimited
  voice coaching, advanced analytics, AI daily planning, and all 6 coach personalities. Every new
  user gets a 7-day free trial of Pro.
*What devices does Vora work with?*
  Vora is available on iPhone (iOS 14.0+) and Apple Watch. It syncs with Apple Health and integrates
  with 500+ fitness platforms including Strava, Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, WHOOP, and MyFitnessPal.
*How does Vora's AI nutrition logging work?*
  Take a photo of your meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and logs detailed
  nutritional information including calories, protein, carbs, fats, and 35+ micronutrients. You can
  also scan barcodes or use voice commands to log food hands-free.
*Is my health data private and secure?*
  Vora never sells your data or uses it for advertising. Your health data is encrypted at rest and
  in transit. HealthKit data is used exclusively for coaching, never for marketing or shared with
  third parties.
*How is Vora different from other fitness apps?*
  Most fitness apps focus on one thing: tracking workouts OR counting calories OR meditation. Vora
  is the only app that combines AI workout programming, photo nutrition logging, recovery and HRV
  tracking, guided meditation, cycle-aware training, and voice coaching in one unified experience -
  replacing 5-6 separate apps.
*Can Vora replace my personal trainer?*
  Vora provides personalized AI coaching that adapts to your goals, schedule, fitness level, and
  recovery status - similar to how a personal trainer would. It programs workouts with progressive
  overload, adjusts based on your performance, and provides real-time voice coaching during
  sessions.
*Does Vora support cycle tracking?*
  Yes. Vora tracks period, fertility, ovulation, and symptoms, and automatically adjusts workout
  recommendations based on your cycle phase for optimized performance.
*Is Vora available on Android?*
  Vora is currently available on iOS (iPhone 8+, iOS 14.0+). Android support is on the roadmap.

## Vora - AI Health Coach for Workouts, Nutrition, Recovery & Meditation

Vora is the all-in-one AI health coach for iPhone. It combines personalized AI workout plans, photo
nutrition logging, recovery tracking, guided meditation, cycle tracking, and voice-first coaching in
a single app. Used by 1,000+ athletes and busy professionals.

## AI-Powered Workout Plans

Get personalized training programs generated by AI based on your goals, fitness level, schedule, and
daily recovery. Choose from 6 distinct AI coach personalities. Progressive overload is tracked
automatically.

## Photo Nutrition Logging

Snap a photo of any meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and provides a full macro and
micronutrient breakdown - calories, protein, carbs, fat, and 35+ nutrients. No manual entry
required. Barcode scanning also available.

## Recovery Tracking & Vora Health Score

A daily 0-100 composite recovery score based on HRV, resting heart rate, sleep quality, and strain.
Vora recommends training intensity based on your recovery state to prevent overtraining.

## Voice-First AI Coaching

Powered by ElevenLabs conversational AI. Log workouts, meals, and health data entirely by voice. Ask
your coach questions, request a meditation session, or get a daily plan - all hands-free on iPhone
and Apple Watch.

## Guided Meditation & Mindfulness

Voice AI-guided meditation sessions on demand. Breathing exercises and mindfulness routines
accessible by voice command on iPhone or Apple Watch.

## Cycle Tracking

Track period, fertility window, ovulation, and symptoms. Workout recommendations automatically adapt
to your menstrual cycle phase for optimized performance and recovery.

## AI Daily Planning

A smart daily timeline with proactive suggestions for workouts, meals, hydration, and rest - adapts
to your calendar, recovery state, and goals.

## Apple Watch & 500+ Integrations

Native Apple Watch app with Live Activities, haptic timers, and voice logging. Connects with Apple
Health, Garmin, Oura, WHOOP, Fitbit, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Peloton, and 500+ more platforms.

## Pricing

Vora is free to download. Vora Pro is $12.99/month or $89.99/year ($7.50/month). Every new user
receives a 7-day free trial of Pro. No commitment required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

*Is Vora free to use?*
  Yes. Vora offers a generous free tier with core features including AI workout plans, basic
  nutrition logging, and recovery tracking. Vora Pro ($12.99/month or $89.99/year) unlocks unlimited
  voice coaching, advanced analytics, AI daily planning, and all 6 coach personalities. Every new
  user gets a 7-day free trial of Pro.
*What devices does Vora work with?*
  Vora is available on iPhone (iOS 14.0+) and Apple Watch. It syncs with Apple Health and integrates
  with 500+ fitness platforms including Strava, Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, WHOOP, and MyFitnessPal.
*How does Vora's AI nutrition logging work?*
  Take a photo of your meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and logs detailed
  nutritional information including calories, protein, carbs, fats, and 35+ micronutrients. You can
  also scan barcodes or use voice commands to log food hands-free.
*Is my health data private and secure?*
  Vora never sells your data or uses it for advertising. Your health data is encrypted at rest and
  in transit. HealthKit data is used exclusively for coaching, never for marketing or shared with
  third parties.
*How is Vora different from other fitness apps?*
  Most fitness apps focus on one thing: tracking workouts OR counting calories OR meditation. Vora
  is the only app that combines AI workout programming, photo nutrition logging, recovery and HRV
  tracking, guided meditation, cycle-aware training, and voice coaching in one unified experience -
  replacing 5-6 separate apps.
*Can Vora replace my personal trainer?*
  Vora provides personalized AI coaching that adapts to your goals, schedule, fitness level, and
  recovery status - similar to how a personal trainer would. It programs workouts with progressive
  overload, adjusts based on your performance, and provides real-time voice coaching during
  sessions.
*Does Vora support cycle tracking?*
  Yes. Vora tracks period, fertility, ovulation, and symptoms, and automatically adjusts workout
  recommendations based on your cycle phase for optimized performance.
*Is Vora available on Android?*
  Vora is currently available on iOS (iPhone 8+, iOS 14.0+). Android support is on the roadmap.

* [[AI model to generate heart animations]Saudi hospital launches remote heart monitoring system
  that detects problems weeks before symptoms appear][15]
  July 23, 2026
  King Abdullah Medical City in Makkah is now using a wireless implant to track heart failure
  patients from home, cutting hospital visits and catching complications early
* [What a pregnant woman eats can shape her child’s health for life, new research shows][16]
  July 23, 2026
  Scientists at Sidra Medicine have found direct links between maternal diet, preterm birth,
  gestational diabetes, and long-term disease risk in children
* [Dubai hospital becomes first in the Gulf to use advanced 3-in-1 heart artery imaging system][17]
  July 23, 2026
  A new optical coherence tomography platform lets cardiologists see inside arteries in real time,
  improving how complex blockages are diagnosed and treated
* [Abu Dhabi researchers find new clue in the fight against Huntington’s disease][18]
  July 23, 2026
  A previously unknown disease mechanism, discovered using patient stem cells, could open new
  treatment paths for a condition that has no cure

  July 23, 2026

  data][20]
  July 23, 2026
  Samsung's new smartwatch lineup gets a major hardware upgrade and a deeper push into AI-powered
  health tracking
* [Egypt’s largest diagnostic lab installs the first Siemens FLEXLAB-X automation track in the
  Middle East and Africa][21]
  July 22, 2026
  Al Mokhtabar's Mega Lab can now process 30,000 samples a day and return results in under 33
  minutes
* [Egyptian diagnostic startup Reme-D raises $1.45 million to scale affordable testing across
  Africa][22]
  July 22, 2026
  The Cairo-based company makes molecular tests for TB, HIV, and cancer that can survive without
  refrigeration, reaching patients in places where cold chains don't exist
* [[Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi implants first remote heart failure monitor in the city]Cleveland
  Clinic Abu Dhabi implants the city’s first remote heart failure monitor][23]
  July 22, 2026
  A tiny sensor placed in the pulmonary artery can now alert doctors to worsening heart failure
  before patients even feel sick
* [Abu Dhabi completes 12 disease registries in major public health push][24]
  July 22, 2026
  The emirate now has a unified system to track how diseases spread, who they affect, and how trends
  shift over time

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]
